# CoverFit — full text for AI agents

CoverFit is a static, browser-only cover studio for self-publishers. It builds a KDP-compliant paperback wrap: back cover, spine, and front cover on one sheet, with 0.125 in bleed per edge. Inputs are trim size, page count, and paper stock. Outputs are a 300 DPI PNG and a single-page PDF. Nothing is uploaded; there is no account.

Site: https://coverfit.app/
Sitemap: https://coverfit.app/sitemap.xml
Contact: fit@coverfit.app

## Core formulas

- Spine width: page count × paper thickness. White = 0.002252 in per page. Cream = 0.0025 in per page.
- Full wrap width: 2 × trim width + spine width + 0.25 in.
- Full wrap height: trim height + 0.25 in.
- Bleed: 0.125 in on each edge. Safe area: 0.25 in inside the trim.
- Export resolution: 300 DPI.

## Coverage

### KDP book cover maker

URL: https://coverfit.app/
Markdown: https://coverfit.app/index.md

Worked examples on the page:

| Trim | Pages | Paper | Spine | Full wrap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6 × 9 in | 320 | Cream | 0.800 in | 13.050 × 9.250 in |
| 6 × 9 in | 320 | White | 0.721 in | 12.971 × 9.250 in |
| 5.5 × 8.5 in | 240 | Cream | 0.600 in | 11.850 × 8.750 in |
| 5 × 8 in | 180 | White | 0.405 in | 10.655 × 8.250 in |
| 8.5 × 11 in | 120 | White | 0.270 in | 17.520 × 11.250 in |

The page also answers: what size a KDP cover should be, how spine width is calculated, whether files are uploaded, and whether the exported PDF can be used for KDP.

### KDP cover template

URL: https://coverfit.app/kdp-cover-template
Markdown: https://coverfit.app/kdp-cover-template.md

Guide zones: bleed (0.125 in outside trim, background art), trim (final cut line, nothing critical), safe area (0.25 in inside trim, all type), barcode zone (lower-right of back cover, roughly 2 × 1.2 in, keep quiet).

Full-wrap dimensions at 6 × 9 in by page count:

| Pages | Spine cream | Wrap cream | Spine white | Wrap white |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 120 | 0.300 | 12.550 × 9.250 | 0.270 | 12.520 × 9.250 |
| 200 | 0.500 | 12.750 × 9.250 | 0.450 | 12.700 × 9.250 |
| 280 | 0.700 | 12.950 × 9.250 | 0.631 | 12.881 × 9.250 |
| 320 | 0.800 | 13.050 × 9.250 | 0.721 | 12.971 × 9.250 |
| 400 | 1.000 | 13.250 × 9.250 | 0.901 | 13.151 × 9.250 |
| 500 | 1.250 | 13.500 × 9.250 | 1.126 | 13.376 × 9.250 |

Rejection causes listed on the page: a template from a different page count, type inside the bleed, 72 DPI design, and a busy back cover under the barcode.

| Pages | White | Cream | Cream mm |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | 0.225 | 0.250 | 6.35 |
| 150 | 0.338 | 0.375 | 9.53 |
| 200 | 0.450 | 0.500 | 12.70 |
| 250 | 0.563 | 0.625 | 15.88 |
| 300 | 0.676 | 0.750 | 19.05 |
| 350 | 0.788 | 0.875 | 22.23 |
| 400 | 0.901 | 1.000 | 25.40 |
| 500 | 1.126 | 1.250 | 31.75 |
| 700 | 1.576 | 1.750 | 44.45 |

Below about 0.25 in there is no usable spine text; between 0.25 and 0.5 in, use the title only. The tool hides spine text automatically below 0.18 in.

### KDP printing cost calculator

URL: https://coverfit.app/printing-cost-calculator
Markdown: https://coverfit.app/printing-cost-calculator.md

Rates used: $0.85 fixed, $0.012 per page black ink, $0.0225 standard color, $0.0575 premium color, 60% paperback royalty minus printing cost. Rates were last reviewed in 2024 and are editable on the page.

| Pages | Black ink | Standard color | Premium color |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 100 | $2.05 | $3.10 | $6.60 |
| 200 | $3.25 | $5.35 | $12.35 |
| 320 | $4.69 | $8.05 | $19.25 |
| 400 | $5.65 | $9.85 | $23.85 |
| 500 | $6.85 | $12.10 | $29.60 |

Excluded: taxes, currency conversion, expanded distribution, hardcover, promotions, and non-standard trim surcharges.

### Book cover design guide

URL: https://coverfit.app/book-cover-design
Markdown: https://coverfit.app/book-cover-design.md

Thumbnail checklist: title readable at 200 px, author visible but not dominant, contrast 4.5:1, three elements or fewer, genre signalled at a glance. Three-level hierarchy: title 30 to 50 percent of cover height, then author, then at most one supporting element. Two type families are enough; avoid hairline serifs and scripts below 24 points. One dominant color and one accent; test in grayscale. The spine is the only surface visible on a shelf. Leave the lower-right 2 × 1.2 in of the back cover free for the barcode.

## About, contact, privacy

- About: https://coverfit.app/about.md — scope, editorial standard, and the explicit non-affiliation with Amazon and KDP.
- Contact: https://coverfit.app/contact.md — fit@coverfit.app, reply in 1 to 3 business days, details to include in a bug report.
- Privacy: https://coverfit.app/privacy.md — images stay in the browser; hosting logs are standard request data; Cloudflare is the host.

## Boundaries

CoverFit computes geometry. It cannot confirm that KDP will accept a file, cannot verify fonts or color profiles, and is not affiliated with Amazon or Kindle Direct Publishing. Every export should be checked in KDP's previewer.
